about: One broken chord per measure, shared between the hands: the left hand plays the first two notes and the right hand answers with three. The aim is a perfectly even stream of notes.
rights: Composition by J. S. Bach (died 1750), public domain. Measures 1–11 with the held notes simplified and a closing chord added for this app.
